content_voiceover: This flowchart shows the fifth edition WHO classification algorithm for MDS, which runs in parallel to the ICC algorithm you just saw but follows a different order of checks. The first branch point asks whether biallelic T P 53 is present. If yes, the diagnosis is MDS dash bi T P 53. If no, the algorithm checks for increased blasts. If blasts are increased, it then asks whether fibrosis is present. Fibrosis present leads to MDS dash f. Fibrosis absent leads to MDS dash I B 2 or MDS dash I B 1, depending on the specific blast range. If blasts are not increased, the algorithm checks for a 5 q deletion. Deletion present leads to a check for minus 7 or 7 q deletion; if that is absent, the diagnosis is MDS dash 5 q. If there is no 5 q deletion, the algorithm checks S F 3 B 1 mutation status. If S F 3 B 1 is mutated and minus 7, 7 q deletion, or complex karyotype is absent, the diagnosis is MDS dash S F 3 B 1. If none of the genetic or blast based categories apply, the final branch asks whether the marrow is hypoplastic. Hypoplastic marrow leads to MDS dash h. Non hypoplastic marrow defaults to MDS dash L B, which stands for low blasts. The dashed arrows show that high risk cytogenetics, minus 7, 7 q deletion, or complex karyotype, redirect cases away from the S F 3 B 1 or del 5 q categories and toward the hypoplastic or low blast pathway instead.
keypoints: Order of checks: biallelic T P 53, then blasts, then del 5 q, then S F 3 B 1, then hypoplastic
Biallelic T P 53 present equals MDS dash bi T P 53, checked first
Increased blasts plus fibrosis equals MDS dash f, otherwise I B 1 or I B 2
Clean del 5 q or clean S F 3 B 1 without high risk cytogenetics get their named category
Default pathway ends at MDS dash h if hypoplastic, or MDS dash L B if not
keypoint_voiceover: Contrast this with the ICC algorithm. Fifth edition WHO checks biallelic T P 53 status first, before even looking at blast percentage, whereas ICC starts with blast percentage. After that, WHO checks increased blasts, then del 5 q, then S F 3 B 1, and finally falls back to hypoplastic MDS or the low blast catch all category, MDS dash L B.
